---
title: "TARVa Figure 4 -- expression versus variant load"
author: "Kat J"
output: html_document
params:
  input_dir: "."
  output_prefix: "Fig4_tpm_variant_correlation"
  alpha: 0.05
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

Reads `tpm_variant_relationship.csv`, written by
`tarva analysispipe expression-correlation --output <dir>`. It computes nothing: every
rho and p-value comes from that step.

Panel A plots each gene's two Spearman coefficients against each other, faceted by gene
subset. Panel B summarises the same genes as proportions. No main title, by request.

`case_condition` and `ref_condition` come from the CSV, so nothing here assumes what the
two groups are called.

```{r load}
df <- read_csv(file.path(params$input_dir, "tpm_variant_relationship.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(nrow(df) > 0)
for (needed in c("case_condition", "ref_condition", "case_rho", "ref_rho",
                 "case_pvalue", "ref_pvalue", "diff_pvalue", "gene_group")) {
  if (!needed %in% names(df)) {
    stop("tpm_variant_relationship.csv has no '", needed,
         "' column -- re-run expression-correlation.")
  }
}

case_condition <- unique(df$case_condition)[1]
ref_condition  <- unique(df$ref_condition)[1]

# Group labels are the dataset's own.
group_levels <- c(
  paste0(case_condition, "_enriched"),
  paste0(ref_condition, "_enriched")
)
group_levels <- c(group_levels[group_levels %in% df$gene_group],
                  setdiff(sort(unique(df$gene_group)), group_levels))

sig_levels <- c("Neither significant",
                paste(case_condition, "only"),
                paste(ref_condition, "only"),
                "Both significant")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    gene_group = factor(gene_group, levels = group_levels),
    case_sig = !is.na(case_pvalue) & case_pvalue < params$alpha,
    ref_sig  = !is.na(ref_pvalue)  & ref_pvalue  < params$alpha,
    diff_sig = !is.na(diff_pvalue) & diff_pvalue < params$alpha,
    sig_group = case_when(
      case_sig &  ref_sig ~ "Both significant",
      case_sig & !ref_sig ~ paste(case_condition, "only"),
      !case_sig & ref_sig ~ paste(ref_condition, "only"),
      TRUE                ~ "Neither significant"
    ),
    sig_group = factor(sig_group, levels = sig_levels),
    diff_sig_label = factor(
      if_else(diff_sig, "Significantly different",
              "Not significantly different"),
      levels = c("Not significantly different", "Significantly different")
    )
  )

# RColorBrewer "Dark2", keyed to this dataset's labels.
sig_colors <- setNames(c("grey80", "#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3"), sig_levels)
outline_colors <- c("Not significantly different" = "grey60",
                    "Significantly different"     = "black")

cat("genes:            ", nrow(df), "\n",
    "case:             ", case_condition, "\n",
    "reference:        ", ref_condition, "\n",
    "with both rho:    ", sum(!is.na(df$case_rho) & !is.na(df$ref_rho)), "\n",
    "subsets:          ", paste(levels(df$gene_group), collapse = ", "), "\n",
    sep = "")
```

```{r panelA, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.6}
plot_df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(case_rho), !is.na(ref_rho))

panelA <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = case_rho, y = ref_rho)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
              linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig_group, color = diff_sig_label),
             shape = 21, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.9, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, breaks = names(sig_colors),
                    name = sprintf("Significant correlations (p < %s)",
                                   params$alpha)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = outline_colors, breaks = names(outline_colors),
                     name = sprintf("Significant difference between\nconditions (p < %s)",
                                    params$alpha)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_group, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = bquote("Spearman" ~ rho ~ "(" * .(case_condition) * ")"),
    y = bquote("Spearman" ~ rho ~ "(" * .(ref_condition) * ")")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = -5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "grey40", alpha = 1),
      nrow = 2, order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "white", alpha = 1), order = 2)
  )

panelA
```

```{r panelB, fig.width=4, fig.height=3.6}
summary_df <- df %>%
  count(gene_group, sig_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(gene_group) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

panelB <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = gene_group, y = pct, fill = sig_group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n > 0, n, "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6,
            color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sig_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of genes in subset") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )

panelB
```

```{r combine, fig.width=10, fig.height=4.6}
# patchwork collects the legend itself via `guides = "collect"`.
combined <- (panelB + panelA) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.3), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")

combined
```

```{r save}
for (ext in c("tiff", "png")) {
  path <- file.path(params$input_dir, paste0(params$output_prefix, ".", ext))
  ggsave(path, combined, width = 10, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = 300,
         compression = if (ext == "tiff") "lzw" else NULL)
  message("wrote ", path)
}
```
